card.name: Ends of foreign-language institution names
card.fires_on: The last or near-last word of a non-English name of an institution, museum or place, usually just before a closing parenthesis or a following 'de' phrase. Seen in Spanish, Portuguese, French, Russian and Japanese names.

modes.label: Romance-language institution names
modes.description: Adjective or noun endings inside Spanish, Portuguese or French organization and museum names.
modes.example: Museo<< Nacional>> del Prado, Spain’s national art

modes.label: Foreign name in parentheses
modes.description: Final word of a foreign-language name given as a gloss in brackets, including Russian and Japanese.

card.writes: Promotes opening quote marks and some capitalized starters, suggesting what comes after a completed name; the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires near the end of a foreign-language name of an institution or museum, such as a Spanish or French title.
